title: VULTURES 2
description: This is the official cover art for VULTURES 2. It features the same styling as the cover for VULTURES 1, but replaces Kanye West and his wife Bianca Censori in favor of Ty Dolla $ign. Ty holds to his chest a photo of his older brother Big TC, who got incarcerated in 2004 to spend the rest of his life in prison for murder. TC alleges to be innocent of the killing. The image in the frame was uploaded to Big TC's Instagram in 2019. Ty has shown a lot of support for his brother's freedom campaign in the past, titling his debut studio album after it and even called for TC's freedom on the titular track of VULTURES 1.
